It matches none of the five known patterns; the agent found it by scanning the card's transaction window for clustered same-band purchases and matched it to earlier confirmed cases with the same signature.

case.summary: Customer C07297 reported an unauthorized online transaction of $482.12 on card C07297-K1. Investigation revealed a rapid burst of four online transactions totaling $1,906.07 within 30 minutes on November 21, 2016, with each transaction amount just under $500. This card is historically used almost exclusively in person, with 194 of 199 earlier transactions being in-person. The bank has confirmed the activity as fraud, blocked the card, and will monitor connected cards.

sar.narrative: This report concerns suspected unauthorized card activity on card C07297-K1 held by customer C07297. Between 2016-11-21 and 2016-11-21, 4 transaction(s) totaling $1,906.07 were identified as part of one fraud episode: 3476602 on 2016-11-21 20:00 for $478.95 (online); 3476633 on 2016-11-21 20:10 for $456.96 (online); 3476665 on 2016-11-21 20:24 for $488.04 (online); 3476682 on 2016-11-21 20:30 for $482.12 (online). The activity was classified as undocumented. 4 online purchases within 30 minutes, each just under $500 ($478.95, $456.96, $488.04, $482.12. This card is used almost only in person (5 of 199 earlier transactions online). The cardholder denied making the transactions. The bank recommends BLOCK_CARD, CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT, ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST; the card block and this filing await human approval under the bank's routing policy.
